verdict.line: You lose if you facetank Judgment spins and let Perseverance tick back up; you win every all-in from level 2 onward if you punish before he heals.

brief.thesis: Camille sits at 53.6% over 869 games here with both lane and solo-kill advantage because her E (Hookshot) gap-close and Q (Precision Protocol) dash reset let her dictate every engage against a champion with zero gap-closer of his own. The entire matchup is a race against Garen's passive: land damage often enough and he never gets to use Perseverance to undo your trades.

theirWindow.when: Garen lands Q silence on engage
theirWindow.what: Decisive Strike silences you and grants him movement speed into an immediate E (Judgment) spin — back off the instant it lands instead of trading through it, since your Q and E are locked out for its duration.

yourWindow.what: Walk up and trade freely with autos and Q; without Judgment he has no answer to your dash-reset poke, and his passive shield (Courage) is only doing half its job with the spin gone.

runes.keystoneWhy: permanent HP growth and free sustain in extended trades reward the stick-and-poke pattern you want against a champion with no way to disengage.

summoners.why: 73.2% pick and the highest winrate of the three loadouts at 55.7% — Ignite denies Perseverance outright during your all-in window, converting your existing solo-kill advantage into an actual kill.

playing.title: Deny Perseverance procs
playing.detail: Garen heals hard if he takes zero damage for several seconds; land at least one auto or ability tick inside that window on every extended trade so the regen never fires.

playing.title: Engage E onto a wall
playing.detail: Hookshot onto terrain behind him doubles your dash distance and comes off cooldown faster than a champion-target hook, letting you close and follow with Q before he can walk away.

playing.title: Bait his Q before committing
playing.detail: Decisive Strike silences and speeds him up; force it out on a minion or juke it before you commit your full combo so it can't cancel your Q or E mid-fight.

playing.title: Lead all-ins with an ability, not an auto
playing.detail: Adaptive Defenses shields you on your first ability hit, so open with Q or E to get the shield active before his Judgment spin starts ticking.

playing.title: Box him with W before ulting
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep's hex slows and reveals inside it; drop it right before R at level 6+ so he can't step out of ultimate range during the execute window.

playing.title: Look for kills right at level 2-3
playing.detail: Your solo-kill edge peaks the moment E unlocks — commit on cannon waves or whenever he pushes to poke, before his level 6 execute changes the math.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.18.1); the tactical reasoning — trade timing, cooldown tracking, and power-spike calls — is my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Try to engage when Camille has her passive shield [P] active. Garen will recover if he does not receive damage for a certain period of time. Deal damage constantly to prevent him from recovering health!
